day.reading: d = 0.80 corrects 252,000 for overlapping generations; critics should have used 201,600; neither Wright-Fisher nor Moran carries the correction

critic.reading: Hancock used the number Duffy presented (evo009@L51); Wright-Fisher/Moran with N_e already account for overlap
critic.holds: attribution is not arithmetic; whether N_e scaling captures what d does is M-107 (open there for selection); 0.80 is not the d in parameters.yaml (0.45, which gives 113,400)

notes: Every input is held verbatim (Q18 and parameters.yaml for 6.3e6/25/252,000; evo009@L54 for 0.80 and 201,600). d multiplies generations (equivalently the generation length is g/d), as M-107 records; the record does not redo whether that correction is needed. The d series in Day's own figures: 0.45 (parameters, Z18166234; 325,000 x 0.45 = 146,250 in the 2025 version) and 0.80 (10-21..10-30 posts); which one MITTENS 3.0 and the book use is M-114.
